assertions.statement: Frozen wikipedia evidence for back-illuminated sensor architecture: rearranges_imaging_elements_to_increase_captured_light_with_cost_and_implementation_history; value = a sensor layout intended to increase captured light and improve low-light performance, with consumer-price introduction in 2009 but without a quantified gain for every exact camera.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Canon EOS 7D kit seller page: shows_an_older_dslr_kit_with_af_burst_and_durability_claims; value = SKU B002LSI1LY at 899.55 dollars, rated 100 percent over eight reviews, with an 18-135mm IS kit title, an 18MP APS-C claim, nineteen-point AF, eight frames per second and shutter durability up to 150,000 cycles.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for Canon EOS 7D model history: places_the_model_in_2009_with_19_cross_type_points_and_eight_frame_per_second_capability; value = a high-end APS-C DSLR announced in September 2009 with an 18MP sensor, nineteen cross-type AF points and eight-frame-per-second capability.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Canon EOS R body and adapter bundle seller page: shows_a_mirrorless_bundle_with_dual_pixel_af_evf_and_adapter_claims; value = SKU B09RTQ2VXP at 1,869 dollars with no posted review, a body, EF-EOS R adapter and 128GB card bundle, plus 30.3MP full-frame, Dual Pixel AF, 5,655 AF-point, EVF, eight-frame-per-second and 4K claims.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for Canon EOS R model history: places_the_model_in_2018_with_dual_pixel_eye_af_dense_selection_and_known_mode_limits; value = Canon's first full-frame mirrorless model released in October 2018 with 30.3MP, Dual Pixel eye AF and up to 5,655 selectable points, while silent electronic readout can produce rolling-shutter skew and the body lacks IBIS.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for active-pixel CMOS sensor development: shows_noise_capability_improvement_and_a_row_readout_tradeoff; value = modern CMOS sensors can outperform earlier CCD noise capability, BSI can mitigate inactive area, and row-wise capture can produce rolling-shutter effects.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for Nikon D7000 model history: places_the_model_in_2010_with_39_point_af_and_six_frame_per_second_capability; value = a 16.2MP DSLR announced in September 2010 with a 39-area AF system, 3D tracking modes and six-frame-per-second capability.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Nikon D7000 renewed-kit seller page: shows_a_renewed_older_dslr_kit_with_seller_specs; value = SKU B08QJQF76H at 799 dollars with no posted review, renewed condition wording, an 18-105mm lens, a 16.2MP DX CMOS claim, six-frame-per-second claim and ISO 100 to 6400 claim.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for photographic dynamic range: describes_a_luminance_range_and_shadow_recovery_noise_boundary; value = dynamic range is a ratio of measurable extremes and in photography concerns the luminance range a scene or camera can capture and how far exposure can be pushed without significantly increasing noise.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for electronic viewfinder: adds_processed_setting_aware_preview_and_focus_aids_with_display_limits; value = an EVF displays the sensor view on a small processed screen, can preview exposure and white balance and show focus aids, but can have display dynamic-range and processing-latency limits.

Frozen postmill evidence for community newer-phone close-focus complaint: reports_a_newer_device_failing_an_older_device_close_focus_task_with_lens_and_mode_differences; value = one author says a newer 14 Plus is blurry at the older XS Max's five-inch distance, while comments identify missing telephoto or macro paths and a different minimum focus distance.

Frozen postmill evidence for community two-year Jupiter progress post: shows_visible_progress_with_retained_core_gear_and_changed_practice_accessories_capture_and_processing; value = the author reports four images over two years with the same core telescope while practice, weather, Barlow choice, tracking, frame count, stacking and editing changed.

Frozen postmill evidence for community used-camera value discussion: contains_both_an_older_prosumer_value_claim_and_a_beginner_defect_risk_warning; value = one commenter recommends older prosumer gear over new entry level and another warns that beginners can be scammed, overpay or miss latent problems, while a third says an old 5D Mark II remains capable for stills.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Nikon Z6 body and FTZ bundle seller page: shows_a_mirrorless_bundle_with_bsi_on_sensor_af_ibis_and_adapter_claims; value = SKU B0934RQLD4 at 1,728 dollars with no posted review, an international-model body, FTZ adapter and 64GB XQD bundle, plus 24.5MP BSI, 273-point phase-detect AF and five-axis sensor-shift stabilization claims.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for Nikon Z6 model history: places_the_model_in_2018_with_bsi_273_point_coverage_and_firmware_evolution; value = a full-frame mirrorless model announced in August 2018 with a 24.5MP back-illuminated sensor, 273 single-point AF positions covering ninety percent and later firmware additions to eye and animal detection.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for rolling shutter readout: records_scene_regions_at_different_times_and_can_distort_motion_or_flashes; value = row or region scanning means the whole scene is not captured at one instant, so fast motion, vibration or flashes can produce skew or wobble unlike a global shutter.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Sony A300 body seller page: shows_an_older_body_with_sensor_shift_stabilization_and_live_view_claims; value = SKU B003J9DC72 at 337.99 dollars with no posted review, a body title, a 10.2MP APS-C CCD claim, Quick AF Live View and body-based Super SteadyShot rated by the seller at 2.5 to 3.5 shutter-speed steps.

Frozen magento evidence for frozen Sony a7 III accessory-bundle seller page: shows_a_2018_generation_mirrorless_body_bundle_with_full_frame_burst_and_video_claims; value = SKU B07XDCPVSL at 1,999 dollars, rated 100 percent over two reviews, with a body-only-labeled bundle, 24.2MP full-frame claim, up to ten frames per second with AF or AE tracking and 4K HDR wording.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for Sony a7 III model history: places_the_model_in_2018_with_bsi_dense_af_eye_tracking_ibis_and_ten_fps; value = a full-frame mirrorless model announced in February 2018 with a 24MP BSI sensor, 693 phase and 425 contrast AF points, eye AF, five-axis in-body stabilization and ten-frame-per-second capability.

Frozen wikipedia evidence for image stabilization: reduces_camera_motion_blur_but_does_not_freeze_subject_motion; value = lens, body or combined stabilization can allow slower handheld shutter speeds by reducing ordinary camera shake, but it does not prevent blur from a moving subject.
